page_title: LYO 3-0 NAN | Lyon v Nantes 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Adam Karabec (Lyon) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

90+9' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lyon.

90+9' Adam Karabec (Lyon) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Anthony Lopes makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
90+7' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
90+6' Matthis Abline (Nantes) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
90+5' The rebound finds Pavel Sulc (Lyon) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
90+5' Adam Karabec (Lyon) sends the corner into the box, but Anthony Lopes intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+3' Dangerous play by Bahmed Deuff (Nantes). Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Khalis Merah.
89' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Fabien Centonze (Nantes) replaces Johann Lepenant.
89' We are about to witness a substitution. Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is replacing Tylel Tati.
88' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
88' Celebrations are cut short for Nantes as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
87' Wait! Referee Abdelatif Kherradji has indicated he is going to review the Nantes goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
86' Bahmed Deuff (Nantes) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
85' Jorge Maciel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Orel Mangala (Lyon) replacing Tyler Morton.
85' Today's match ends for Martin Satriano who will be replaced by Adam Karabec (Lyon).
84' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
80' The game is interrupted.
78' Luis Castro decides to make a substitution. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon will be replaced by Uros Radakovic (Nantes).
77' 3 - 0 Goal! Afonso Moreira produces a great pass that finds Martin Satriano (Lyon) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot high into the net. 3:0.
75' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
73' Tyler Morton (Lyon) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

73' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Jorge Maciel prepares a substitution. Mathys de Carvalho is replaced by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
72' It's time for a substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) comes on in place of Hans Hateboer.
70' 2 - 0 GOAL! Martin Satriano (Lyon) scores in ugly fashion, sending the ball into the net via a miscued scissor kick direct from a lofted ball into the box. It’s 2:0.
70' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
70' The match can continue after the interruption.
64' The match has to be interrupted due to technical problems.
61' Tyler Morton (Lyon) sends a chip pass into the box, but Anthony Lopes is quickest to intercept the ball.
59' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Youssef El Arabi and he is replaced by Bahmed Deuff (Nantes).
58' Substitution. Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mayckel Lahdo walks off.

58' Matthis Abline (Nantes) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
57' Tyler Morton (Lyon) picks up a yellow card.
57' The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
55' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Anthony Lopes makes a comfortable save.
51' 1 - 0 Goal! Abner Vinicius (Lyon) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
51' Tyler Morton (Lyon) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
49' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
47' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45+1' Close! Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Junior Mwanga (Nantes) has to leave the pitch!

41' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Junior Mwanga (Nantes), but referee Abdelatif Kherradji must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
40' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

37' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Abdelatif Kherradji with no other option than to blow for a foul.
33' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
30' Martin Satriano (Lyon) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
26' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
25' Great save! Pavel Sulc (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Anthony Lopes.
22' What was Tylel Tati (Nantes) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
15' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
14' A player from Nantes commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
14' Unbelievable miss! Junior Mwanga (Nantes) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
13' Tyler Morton (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Abdelatif Kherradji stops the game and makes a call.

9' Ambitious effort from Matthis Abline (Nantes). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
8' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
7' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
6' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.

5' Matthis Abline (Nantes) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Dominik Greif pulls off an easy save.
3' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will officiate today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
